ddl.where: "deleted_at" is null and "staff_id" is not null
ddl.name: memberships_staff_uq

ddl.where: "deleted_at" is null and "guardian_id" is not null
ddl.name: memberships_guardian_uq

ddl.where: "deleted_at" is null and "student_id" is not null
ddl.name: memberships_student_uq

ddl.where: "number" is not null and "deleted_at" is null
ddl.name: generated_documents_number_uq

ddl.value: "email" is not null or "phone" is not null
ddl.name: invitations_contact_chk

ddl.value:
("kind" = 'staff' and "staff_id" is not null and "guardian_id" is null and "student_id" is null)
       or ("kind" = 'guardian' and "guardian_id" is not null and "staff_id" is null and "student_id" is null)
       or ("kind" = 'student' and "student_id" is not null and "staff_id" is null and "guardian_id" is null)
ddl.name: memberships_person_chk

ddl.value: "ends_at" is null or "starts_at" is null or "ends_at" <= "starts_at" + interval '60 minutes'
ddl.name: support_sessions_length_chk

ddl.using: (not (select app.is_staff()) or (select app.all_branches()) or "branch_settings"."branch_id" = any ((select app.branch_ids())::uuid[]))
ddl.withCheck: (not (select app.is_staff()) or (select app.all_branches()) or "branch_settings"."branch_id" = any ((select app.branch_ids())::uuid[]))
ddl.name: branch_settings_branch

ddl.using: (not (select app.is_staff()) or (select app.all_branches()) or "rooms"."branch_id" = any ((select app.branch_ids())::uuid[]))
ddl.withCheck: (not (select app.is_staff()) or (select app.all_branches()) or "rooms"."branch_id" = any ((select app.branch_ids())::uuid[]))
ddl.name: rooms_branch

ddl.using: (not (select app.is_staff()) or (select app.all_branches()) or "wings"."branch_id" = any ((select app.branch_ids())::uuid[]))
ddl.withCheck: (not (select app.is_staff()) or (select app.all_branches()) or "wings"."branch_id" = any ((select app.branch_ids())::uuid[]))
ddl.name: wings_branch

ddl.using:
(select app.is_staff()) and exists (
        select 1 from memberships m
        where m.user_id = "profiles"."id" and m.org_id = (select app.org_id()) and m.deleted_at is null
      )
ddl.name: profiles_org_read
